Scope: row 29 source/contract review, with a read-only execution of the actual scorer; this is not whole-task clearance. Inspected the actual frozen XLSX with openpyxl: Quality Checks!A30:D30 says the real gates and every scored in-dimension gate must hard-zero blank/static shells and must NOT require same-origin. Internal Quality Checks!A30:D30 retains older cross-origin wording, which is interpretation only and is superseded by the shipped public-network profile. Also inspected actual Deterministic Checks rows 5, 28, 29 and 33. Applied frozen quality-checks.md:123-125, staged-task-contract.md sections tests/scoring.toml, tests/test.sh and prompt.md/app_context.md, deterministic-checks.md check-rubric-prompt/check-scoring-policy recipes, and qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (Gates must exclude convincing dead apps; independent outcome credit; runtime evidence). Independently hashed all 50 frozen task files and all manifest-listed frozen rule files; no mismatches.

.qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/tests/gates/render/judge.toml:15 uses all_pass with one binary criterion. Lines 23-27 reject blank/noninteractive placeholders and require a fresh authored document.body.textContent marker plus console.log marker actually observed after pressing Run; the editor merely containing source is explicitly insufficient. .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/tests/gates/render/prompt.md:14-20 restricts this to basic access/execution and explicitly says not to add same-origin restrictions. .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-29 requires health, an actual successful UI Save/write response, then the identical identity/title/filename/source from a server response or server-rendered document in an independent clean context and again after reload. It explicitly rejects health/static seed/localStorage/toast-only proof, a same-context new tab, and guessing schema or routes. .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/tests/gates/constraints/prompt.md:15-33 restates this gate and gives the clean newContext lifecycle without copied storage. Both gates use Playwright MCP and binary all_pass.

.qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:5 explicitly says an observed global browser gate failure "zeros this dimension"; it requires a reloaded usable editor/preview/console and server-supplied library data. .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/tests/scored/polish/prompt.md:13-22 requires the same prerequisite and says "assign binary 0 to every criterion" on failure. .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/tests/scored/visual/prompt.md:24-33 requires the same prerequisite and says "assign raw anchor 1 to every visual criterion, which normalizes to zero"; lines 39-41 state the 1-5 normalization. The visual judge declares all six criteria likert with points=5; Functional and Polish declare all 64 and 7 criteria binary. These prompts explicitly retain local credit after ordinary feature failures; the hard zero applies only to the global prerequisite. Earlier execution/write gates are not unnecessarily repeated.

.qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/instruction.md:1 explicitly requests no sign-in, agreeing with all gate/scored prompts and .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/tests/app_context.md:8, so auth checks are inapplicable. instruction.md:9 and environment/instructions/integration.md:11 permit external frontend assets. Gate prompts explicitly prohibit same-origin restrictions; functional/prompt.md:13 permits external assets/CDNs and a second local loopback preview hostname; app_context.md:20 confines networking restrictions to entered snippet code. The gate accepts server-rendered records without a JSON/list endpoint. app_context.md:16 explicitly prevents missing Auto-run from failing unrelated gates; observed manual Run must still work.

.qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/tests/scoring.toml:1-3 puts both gate thresholds at 0.0. tests/test.sh:213-224 runs gates, executes score.py, and exits on gate-failure status before the scored suite. tests/tools/score.py:40-48 requires both scores above their thresholds and otherwise forces scored dimensions and final reward to zero. Executed that exact main function with in-memory input/output paths (no task or log writes): gate scores (render=0,constraints=1) and (1,0), even alongside synthetic F=P=V=1, each returned exit 1, gates_passed=0 and reward=0; (1,1) with F=P=V=1 returned exit 0/reward=1. This verifies scorer mechanics only, not whether the configured judge correctly recognizes an app.

Adversarial alternatives: a conforming app can use CDN editor assets, an opaque preview, server-rendered library forms rather than JSON APIs, different usable labels, and an initially empty library; the gate explicitly accommodates these. A beautiful inert mock with a static health response cannot satisfy the authored Run; a browser-only working runner with localStorage saves cannot satisfy fresh-context server retrieval. A missing Auto-run convenience feature does not invalidate a successful manual Run under injected context. No credible false-pass/false-fail witness for this row was found by these source-level traces.

Runtime boundary: raw-evidence-index.json and the inspected raw RESULTS.json identify direct pinned Playwright product observations, not the configured judge. Independently verified RESULTS.json SHA256 ec88c00c12336257196e209f427a40690b76b4d3fc7f283656bc67735cf1bc09 and all actual_app_files against the frozen golden bytes; all matched. Its sampled S01/S14/S15/S16 and S22/S23 observations do not establish a full judge execution of these gate prompts. No full configured judge/Oracle/target-model result or judge timing is claimed. Source presence/correctness is confirmed; execution by the configured judge remains unmeasured.
